jobs.description: Are you a fabricator / welder looking for a greater technical challenge? Read on! For one of our clients near Venray, we are looking for a fabricator / welder. If you have a strong technical background and a willingness to learn, the rest can be taught in the workplace. Wat bieden wij je? What can you expect as a fabricator / welder? A gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €3,600, depending on your experience and qualifications Travel expense reimbursement A challenging position within a growing and innovative company A full-time day shift role Strong focus on personal growth and professional development This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic organization where you will work on unique and technically demanding projects while continuing to develop your skills and expertise. Functieomschrijving As a fabricator / welder, you will drill, bend, saw, and assemble curved components for a wide range of projects, including architectural structures, heavy offshore constructions, complex 3D roller coaster frameworks, and more. Your responsibilities as a Fabricator/Welder include: Reading and interpreting technicaldrawings Independently carrying out various fabrication tasks, such as drilling, bending, sawing, and welding curved components Moving and positioning products using lifting equipment and hoisting tools Interested? Are you ready for a greater technical challenge and would like to work as a fabricator / welder? Apply today via the application button, or contact our office in Venray at +31 (0)478 799 010 for more information.
